+

+def solve_ik(goal_pos, goal_rot, seed=None):
+    """Numerical Panda IK using only MuJoCo forward kinematics."""
+    original = d.qpos[arm_ids].copy()
+    seed = original.copy() if seed is None else np.asarray(seed, dtype=float).copy()
+    goal_pos = np.asarray(goal_pos, dtype=float)
+    goal_rot = np.asarray(goal_rot, dtype=float)
+
+    def residual(q):
+        d.qpos[arm_ids] = q
+        mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
+        p, R = pose()
+        rv = Rotation.from_matrix(goal_rot.T @ R).as_rotvec()
+        return np.r_[(p - goal_pos) * 2.0, rv * 0.28, (q - seed) * 0.008]
+
+    res = least_squares(
+        residual,
+        seed,
+        bounds=(arm_limits[:, 0] + 1e-4, arm_limits[:, 1] - 1e-4),
+        max_nfev=120,
+        ftol=1e-8,
+        xtol=1e-8,
+        gtol=1e-8,
+    )
+    q = res.x.copy()
+    d.qpos[arm_ids] = original
+    mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
+    d.qpos[arm_ids] = q
+    mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
+    p, R = pose()
+    p_err = float(np.linalg.norm(p - goal_pos))
+    r_err = float(np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(goal_rot.T @ R).as_rotvec()))
+    d.qpos[arm_ids] = original

+

+        actions.append(cmd.copy())
